component.name: catselector
component.script:
function IsValid(value as Dynamic) as Boolean return (Type(value) <> "<uninitialized>" and value <> invalid) end function
function itemContentChanged() ' Ensure nodes are initialized (onChange can fire before init) if not isValid(m.itemImage) then m.itemImage = m.top.findNode("itemImage") end if if not isValid(m.itemText) then m.itemText = m.top.findNode("itemText") end if if not isValid(m.itemFont) and isValid(m.itemText) then m.itemFont = m.itemText.font end if itemData = m.top.itemContent if isValid(itemData) if isValid(m.itemImage) and isValid(itemData.posterUrl) m.itemImage.uri = itemData.posterUrl end if if isValid(m.itemText) and isValid(itemData.labelText) m.itemText.text = itemData.labelText end if end if ' isTextEllipsized has a significant lag between the text being ellipsized and the determination that it is. ' see https://forums.roku.com/viewtopic.php?t=104425&p=565559#p565638 for more information on why this has to be done this way. if isValid(m.itemText) and isValid(m.itemFont) if m.itemText.text.split("").Count() > 12 m.itemFont.size = m.itemFont.size - (m.itemText.text.split("").Count() / 12) end if end if end function
function init() m.itemImage = m.top.findNode("itemImage") m.itemText = m.top.findNode("itemText") m.itemFont = m.itemText.font end function
